label.en: Ending: the demon incursion takes the world

note.zh: 星球与星系归恶魔入侵国家所有，由堕落的骑士领导并获得舰队；选项二让玩家改为操控这个新国家。
note.en: The planet and system pass to the Demon Incursion country, led by the corrupted Knight with a fleet; the second option switches the player to that country.

notes.zh: 审阅注：前因在另一个故事里：“传送门”（colony.3005）的地狱结果3006中，毒性骑士起源可派骑士进入传送门；3600–4500天后以25%（干扰性玩法被屏蔽时为0）触发3050，恶魔陆军出现在星球上。若守军在地面战中失败（on_colony_defenders_lose），触发本事件。
notes.en: Review note: the cause sits in another story: in The Doorway's hell outcome (3006) a Toxic Knights empire may send a knight through; 3600–4500 days later, at 25% (0 if disruptive gameplay is blocked), 3050 spawns demon armies on the planet. If the defenders lose the ground battle (on_colony_defenders_lose) this event fires.

scope.en: The one-page Daemonic Incursion ending; false links suppressed.
